brief.subject: [HardStop Demo] Relay launch presentation — producer amendment
brief.body:
FICTIONAL DEMO BRIEF — this Gmail draft is a test fixture, not a received customer email.

The slot has changed. The complete recorded presentation must now be no longer than 90 seconds. The pilot result, disclaimer and final call to action are mandatory. Keep the pilot context before the result. The rollout discussion must be removed. Favor the workflow demonstration over the opening and problem discussion when space allows. Preserve the original narration and source order.

This replaces the previous timing instruction. Delivery: a playable video in the project Dropbox folder, a matching copied Google Slides deck, and an unsent handoff draft. Do not send anything.

Uploading the cut to Dropbox and downloading it again to verify exact bytes
Creating an unaddressed Gmail handoff draft with verified delivery evidence
Verified delivery ready for review. No email sent.
